title: Initial Configuration Lies in the Window
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $q_0$ be a state, let $x$ be an input word, and let $s$ be a nonnegative integer. In the initial configuration on $x$ with starting state $q_0$, every work-tape head is at a position of absolute value at most $s$, and every work-tape cell at an integer position $z$ with $|z|>s$ is blank.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number $k$ of work tapes
